page.layout: One page of text, two columns of body text not present; single column of text with marginal notes in the right margin (two "NB." notes). Running head at top, page number at top right, signature at foot.

main_text.p: Ex Oleis magis probantur, Oleum ex bac-cis juniperi, lauri, femine anisi, fœniculi, cymi-ni, ex hyssopo, thymo, spica, cinnamomo, ga-ryophyllis (hæc duo pretiosissima sunt) nuce mo-schata, mace, succino albo, terebinthinū, &c.

p.i: Quia vero olea facile diffluunt, præstat in un-guento consistentiam ea redigere, vasculoq; in au-rato vel argenteo inclusa conservare.

main_text.head: Unguentum odoriferum pro delicatioribus.
main_text.p: Recip. ambræ, moschi, zibetti, singul. granau-i, olei garyoph. vel cinnamomi, &c. guttas ij, cum oleo amygdalarum dulcium fiat unguen-tum.
main_text.head: Aliud pretiosissimum.
main_text.p: Recip. moschi, gr. vj. ol. garyoph. guttas iij. ambr. gr. ij. zibetti gr. viij. cum oleo e nuce mo-schata expresso ad drachm. unam, f. unguentum,
main_text.head: Aliud.
Minus carum, & tamen efficax.
main_text.p: Recip. ol. thymi, hyssopi, sing. guttas iij, ol. spicæ gutt. ij. ol. ex nuce moschata expressi drachm. semis vel scrup. duos, f. unguentum.

p.i: Qui vero eiusmodi habitacula obtinent, aqua vel plaudum, vel stagnorum rancori, vel etiam limi inquinamentis obuia sunt, & subiecta, ut dent operam, ut domus valuæ sint perflabiles & vento quidem septentrionis, vel orientis, vel aer recti fi-

page.notes: Two marginal "NB." notes in the right margin, beside the paragraphs "Quia vero" and "Qui vero". A faint mark in the right margin beside "Recip. moschi" and another faint mark in the left margin near "Minus carum" are too indistinct to read; not transcribed. The running head is printed "PROROGANDA." The last line "recti fi-" ends in a printed hyphen and continues on the next page. Headings "Aliud pretiosissimum.", "Aliud." and "Minus carum, & tamen efficax." are set in italic display type and are marked as level 3; the "Unguentum odoriferum" title is level 2.
